<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1600 1200" width="1600" height="1200">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="1600" height="1200" fill="#e8f4f8"/>
  
  <!-- Ground line -->
  <line x1="0" y1="950" x2="1600" y2="950" stroke="#8B6914" stroke-width="3"/>
  
  <!-- Ground fill -->
  <rect x="0" y="950" width="1600" height="250" fill="#c8a45a"/>
  
  <!-- Sky gradient -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#87CEEB"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d4eaf7"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="dirtGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c8a45a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a0784a"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="1600" height="950" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="950" width="1600" height="250" fill="url(#dirtGrad)"/>
  
  <!-- Distant mountains -->
  <polygon points="0,700 200,480 400,700" fill="#b0c4d8" opacity="0.5"/>
  <polygon points="300,700 550,430 800,700" fill="#a8bccf" opacity="0.5"/>
  <polygon points="700,700 950,460 1200,700" fill="#b0c4d8" opacity="0.5"/>
  <polygon points="1100,700 1350,440 1600,700" fill="#a8bccf" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="1400" cy="150" r="80" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.9"/>
  <line x1="1400" y1="40" x2="1400" y2="10" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="1400" y1="260" x2="1400" y2="290" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="1290" y1="150" x2="1260" y2="150" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="1510" y1="150" x2="1540" y2="150" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="1322" y1="72" x2="1300" y2="50" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="1478" y1="228" x2="1500" y2="250" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="1478" y1="72" x2="1500" y2="50" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="1322" y1="228" x2="1300" y2="250" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="4"/>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!-- BICYCLE - upside down, resting on handlebars/seat on ground  -->
  <!-- Wheel radius ~95px, T-Rex ~3.5m tall scaled to ~420px        -->
  <!-- Bike center X=800, wheels touch ground at Y=950              -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->

  <!-- Bike color palette -->
  <!-- Frame: dark steel blue, wheels: charcoal -->

  <!-- Wheel centers: left at (560, 855), right at (1040, 855)      -->
  <!-- Wheels upside down so axles are UP, tires touch ground Y=950 -->
  <!-- wheel radius = 95px -->

  <!-- LEFT WHEEL (rear wheel in normal orientation) -->
  <circle cx="560" cy="855" r="95" fill="none" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="10"/>
  <!-- Spokes -->
  <line x1="560" y1="760" x2="560" y2="950" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="465" y1="855" x2="655" y2="855" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="492" y1="788" x2="628" y2="922" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="628" y1="788" x2="492" y2="922" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="474" y1="821" x2="646" y2="889" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="646" y1="821" x2="474" y2="889" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- Hub -->
  <circle cx="560" cy="855" r="14" fill="#555" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- Axle nub (points upward since inverted) -->
  <rect x="548" y="755" width="24" height="14" rx="4" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- RIGHT WHEEL (front wheel) -->
  <circle cx="1040" cy="855" r="95" fill="none" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="10"/>
  <!-- Spokes -->
  <line x1="1040" y1="760" x2="1040" y2="950" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="945" y1="855" x2="1135" y2="855" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="972" y1="788" x2="1108" y2="922" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="1108" y1="788" x2="972" y2="922" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="954" y1="821" x2="1126" y2="889" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="1126" y1="821" x2="954" y2="889" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <circle cx="1040" cy="855" r="14" fill="#555" stroke="#222" stroke-width="3"/>
  <rect x="1028" y="755" width="24" height="14" rx="4" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- FRAME (inverted) - main triangle -->
  <!-- Bottom bracket (now top, ~Y=710) at X=780 -->
  <!-- Seat tube goes UP from BB to seat at Y=620, X=780 -->
  <!-- Chain stay from BB to rear axle (560,760) -->
  <!-- Seat stay from seat post top to rear axle -->
  <!-- Down tube from BB to head tube at front axle -->
  <!-- Top tube (now bottom tube) from seat post to head tube -->

  <!-- Chain stay: BB(780,710) to rear axle stub(560,760) -->
  <line x1="780" y1="710" x2="560" y2="760" stroke="#1a3a6b" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Seat stay: seat cluster(780,620) to rear axle stub(560,760) -->
  <line x1="780" y1="615" x2="560" y2="760" stroke="#1a3a6b" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Seat tube: BB(780,710) to seat cluster(780,615) -->
  <line x1="780" y1="710" x2="780" y2="615" stroke="#1a3a6b" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Down tube: BB(780,710) to head tube bottom(1040,760) -->
  <line x1="780" y1="710" x2="1040" y2="760" stroke="#1a3a6b" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Top tube (horizontal, now at bottom): seat cluster(780,615) to head tube top(1040,710) -->
  <line x1="780" y1="615" x2="1040" y2="710" stroke="#1a3a6b" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Head tube: (1040,760) to (1040,710) -->
  <line x1="1040" y1="760" x2="1040" y2="710" stroke="#1a3a6b" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- BB shell -->
  <circle cx="780" cy="710" r="18" fill="#1a3a6b" stroke="#0d2244" stroke-width="4"/>
  <!-- Crank arms (inverted, pointing sideways/upward) -->
  <line x1="780" y1="710" x2="820" y2="665" stroke="#333" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="780" y1="710" x2="740" y2="755" stroke="#333" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <rect x="822" y="655" width="36" height="12" rx="4" fill="#222" transform="rotate(-30,840,661)"/>
  <rect x="704" y="755" width="36" height="12" rx="4" fill="#222" transform="rotate(-30,722,761)"/>
  <!-- Chain ring -->
  <circle cx="780" cy="710" r="42" fill="none" stroke="#b8860b" stroke-width="5"/>

  <!-- SEAT POST going upward (inverted so seat is above frame) -->
  <line x1="780" y1="615" x2="780" y2="530" stroke="#1a3a6b" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Saddle (upside-down, now pointing up) -->
  <!-- Saddle rails -->
  <line x1="750" y1="530" x2="810" y2="530" stroke="#555" stroke-width="5"/>
  <!-- Saddle shape (inverted, curved part faces down) -->
  <path d="M745,530 Q780,510 815,530" fill="none" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M745,530 Q760,522 780,520 Q800,522 815,530 L815,536 Q800,534 780,532 Q760,534 745,536 Z" fill="#cc3300" stroke="#881100" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- FORK (inverted, goes upward from head tube to front axle area) -->
  <!-- Fork crown at top of head tube -->
  <line x1="1040" y1="710" x2="1010" y2="660" stroke="#1a3a6b" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="1040" y1="710" x2="1070" y2="660" stroke="#1a3a6b" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- HANDLEBAR STEM (going upward from head tube top, inverted) -->
  <line x1="1040" y1="760" x2="1040" y2="690" stroke="#555" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handlebar crossbar - now at the bottom resting on ground area -->
  <!-- Handlebars rest on ground: Y~950, but stem connects at head tube -->
  <!-- Actually the bike is inverted: handlebars touch ground -->
  <!-- Let's redo: handlebar stem extends DOWNWARD from head tube toward ground -->
  <!-- We'll show it going down from head tube bottom to handlebar near ground -->
  <line x1="1040" y1="760" x2="1040" y2="870" stroke="#555" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handlebar grips touching near ground level (Y~920) -->
  <line x1="990" y1="900" x2="1090" y2="900" stroke="#333" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Stem to bar connection -->
  <line x1="1040" y1="870" x2="1040" y2="902" stroke="#555" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Grip tape ends -->
  <rect x="985" y="895" width="18" height="13" rx="4" fill="#cc2200"/>
  <rect x="1094" y="895" width="18" height="13" rx="4" fill="#cc2200"/>

  <!-- ============================================================ -->
  <!-- T-REX - inverted, doing a handstand on the pedals/frame      -->
  <!-- T-Rex is roughly 4m tall = ~480px in this scene              -->
  <!-- Body center around X=780, legs reaching DOWN to pedals       -->
  <!-- Head at top (Y~140 when inverted = high up)                  -->
  <!-- ============================================================ -->

  <!-- T-Rex color: olive green with lighter belly -->
  <!-- The rex is upside down: feet near pedals (~Y655-755), body goes UP -->
  <!-- Hip center: ~(780, 640) just above pedals -->
  <!-- Torso goes up to ~(780, 380) -->
  <!-- Neck and head above that -->
  <!-- Tail extends to the left and down from hips -->

  <!-- TAIL (extends from hip area, curves left and upward in inverted pose) -->
  <!-- In inverted rex: tail would naturally droop. Let's have it arc leftward -->
  <path d="M700,640 Q580,600 480,560 Q380,520 300,480 Q240,450 200,420" 
        fill="none" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="28" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M700,640 Q580,600 480,560 Q380,520 300,480 Q240,450 200,420" 
        fill="none" stroke="#6a8c34" stroke-width="20" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tail tip -->
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="418" rx="22" ry="12" fill="#6a8c34" transform="rotate(-20,195,418)"/>

  <!-- HIPS / PELVIS -->
  <ellipse cx="780" cy="635" rx="70" ry="45" fill="#5a7a2a" stroke="#3d5c1a" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- LEFT LEG (dinosaur's left, our left) - reaching down to left pedal -->
  <!-- Upper leg: hip to knee -->
  <path d="M740,650 Q700,700 680,750" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="38" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Lower leg: knee to ankle -->
  <path d="M680,750 Q660,790 660,820" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="28" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Foot gripping pedal area -->
  <path d="M660,820 Q648,840 640,850" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="22" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Claws/toes on pedal -->
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="855" rx="30" ry="14" fill="#4a6a1a" transform="rotate(20,640,855)"/>
  <line x1="625" y1="860" x2="605" y2="875" stroke="#3d5c10" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="640" y1="862" x2="628" y2="880" stroke="#3d5c10" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="655" y1="858" x2="648" y2="876" stroke="#3d5c10" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- RIGHT LEG - reaching to right pedal area -->
  <path d="M820,650 Q860,700 880,750" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="38" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M880,750 Q900,790 900,820" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="28" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M900,820 Q912,840 920,850" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="22" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Foot/toes -->
  <ellipse cx="920" cy="855" rx="30" ry="14" fill="#4a6a1a" transform="rotate(-20,920,855)"/>
  <line x1="905" y1="860" x2="885" y2="875" stroke="#3d5c10" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="920" y1="862" x2="912" y2="880" stroke="#3d5c10" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="935" y1="858" x2="942" y2="876" stroke="#3d5c10" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- TORSO - from hips upward -->
  <!-- Main body bulk -->
  <path d="M715,640 Q740,450 760,380 Q780,340 800,380 Q820,450 840,640 Z" 
        fill="#6a8c34" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Belly (lighter) -->
  <path d="M745,640 Q755,480 768,400 Q778,360 792,400 Q805,480 815,640 Z" 
        fill="#a8c860" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- Body outline more organic -->
  <ellipse cx="780" cy="510" rx="68" ry="140" fill="#6a8c34" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- Belly stripe -->
  <ellipse cx="780" cy="510" rx="38" ry="110" fill="#9ab850"/>

  <!-- Spine/dorsal texture -->
  <path d="M775,375 Q772,360 775,345 Q778,335 781,345 Q784,360 781,375" fill="#4a6a1a"/>
  <path d="M775,395 Q772,382 775,370 Q778,362 781,370 Q784,382 781,395" fill="#4a6a1a"/>
  <path d="M775,415 Q772,403 775,393 Q778,386 781,393 Q784,403 781,415" fill="#4a6a1a"/>

  <!-- TINY FORELIMBS (T-Rex arms, comically small) -->
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d="M742,470 Q710,480 695,500 Q688,515 692,525" 
        stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="18" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Left hand claws -->
  <line x1="692" y1="525" x2="678" y2="538" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="692" y1="525" x2="682" y2="542" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="692" y1="525" x2="700" y2="540" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d="M818,470 Q850,480 865,500 Q872,515 868,525" 
        stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="18" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Right hand claws -->
  <line x1="868" y1="525" x2="882" y2="538" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="868" y1="525" x2="878" y2="542" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="868" y1="525" x2="860" y2="540" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- NECK - from torso top to head, inverted rex so neck goes further UP -->
  <path d="M765,365 Q755,310 750,270 Q748,240 755,220" 
        stroke="#6a8c34" stroke-width="42" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M795,365 Q805,310 810,270 Q812,240 805,220" 
        stroke="#6a8c34" stroke-width="42" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Neck fill -->
  <path d="M755,365 Q745,300 742,255 Q740,225 752,210 Q780,200 808,210 Q820,225 818,255 Q815,300 805,365 Z"
        fill="#6a8c34" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Neck belly -->
  <path d="M768,360 Q760,300 758,260 Q758,232 780,224 Q802,232 802,260 Q800,300 792,360 Z"
        fill="#9ab850"/>

  <!-- HEAD - large, inverted (jaw pointing up since rex is upside down) -->
  <!-- Head center around (780, 155) -->
  <!-- In inverted pose: the top of skull is near Y=90, jaw opens upward -->

  <!-- Skull -->
  <ellipse cx="780" cy="170" rx="90" ry="68" fill="#6a8c34" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="3"/>
  
  <!-- Upper jaw (in reality the lower jaw - inverted) - opens upward -->
  <!-- Since rex is inverted, lower jaw points UP -->
  <!-- Snout extends to the right -->
  <path d="M780,145 Q870,130 940,140 Q960,148 950,162 Q870,168 780,165 Z"
        fill="#6a8c34" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Lower jaw (skull side, points downward since inverted = faces ground) -->
  <path d="M780,172 Q870,172 938,175 Q956,182 948,195 Q860,198 780,192 Z"
        fill="#7a9c3e" stroke="#4a6a1a" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- MOUTH OPEN (inverted - opens upward, teeth pointing up) -->
  <!-- Upper teeth row (now pointing up since jaw is inverted) -->
  <path d="M790,148 Q870,132 935,142" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Individual teeth (pointing upward = downward in reality) -->
  <polygon points="800,148 805,128 810,148" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="818,145 823,124 828,145" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="836,142 841,121 846,142" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="854,140 859,120 864,140" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="872,139 877,119 882,139" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="890,140 895,121 900,140" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="908,142 913,124 918,142" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="924,145 929,128 934,145" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Lower teeth row (pointing downward = normal orientation teeth) -->
  <polygon points="802,190 807,210 812,190" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="820,191 825,212 830,191" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="838,192 843,213 848,192" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="856,192 861,212 866,192" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="874,192 879,212 884,192" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="892,192 897,211 902,192" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="910,192 915,210 920,192" fill="white" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Tongue (flapping upward since mouth opens upward) -->
  <path d="M820,155 Q860,138 900,148" fill="none" stroke="#cc4444" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Eye - since rex is inverted, eye position is on underside of head -->
  <!-- Eye on the skull, which faces left/up -->
  <!-- Right eye (visible) -->
  <circle cx="730" cy="148" r="22" fill="#f0f0d0" stroke="#3d5c1a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="735" cy="145" r="13" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="740" cy="140" r="4" fill="white"/>
  <!-- Brow ridge (inverted, brow is now below eye) -->
  <path d="M710,160 Q730,165 750,160" fill="#4a6a1a" stroke="#3d5c1a" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Left eye (partially visible) -->
  <circle cx="830" cy="148" r="18" fill="#f0f0d0" stroke="#3d5c1a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="834" cy="145" r="10" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="838" cy="141" r="3" fill="white"/>

  <!-- Nostril (on snout, inverted) -->
  <ellipse cx="912" cy="150" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#3d5c1a" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Scale/texture dots on body -->
  <circle cx="760" cy="520" r="4" fill="#4a6a1a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="800" cy="510" r="4" fill="#4a6a1a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="760" cy="550" r="4" fill="#4a6a1a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="800" cy="540" r="4" fill="#4a6a1a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="775" cy="480" r="4" fill="#4a6a1a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="785" cy="460" r="3" fill="#4a6a1a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="760" cy="590" r="4" fill="#4a6a1a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="800" cy="580" r="4" fill="#4a6a1a" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Ground shadow under bike -->
  <ellipse cx="800" cy="952" rx="260" ry="18" fill="#8B6914" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- Small label - minimal, just contextual -->
  <text x="800" y="1060" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="26" fill="#5a3a10" opacity="0.7" font-style="italic">T. rex · handstand cycling · 1:~60 scale</text>

</svg>

render.rendering: white background, longest side 1600 px; original aspect ratio

grade.verdict: 恐龙与自行车都能一眼认出，但画面呈现的是恐龙直立跨站在车旁、双脚落地，既不是倒立，也读不出骑行关系；解题主要依赖底部那行文字，而不是画面本身。
strengths: 恐龙与自行车两个主体都清晰可辨：绿身、大颚与白牙的头部、细长尾巴和两只小前肢，以及双轮带辐条的车，轮廓易读。
恐龙与车之间的尺度差被有意拉开，车轮相对恐龙身体明显偏小，至少在方向上回应了“真实大小比例”的问题，而不是把两件事画成同等大小。
配色统一克制，天空蓝、地面土黄、恐龙绿与浅色三角山形形成清楚的前后层次，主体没有与背景混作一片。
weaknesses: 动作关系不成立：恐龙是直立体态，头部在上、尾巴扬起、双脚落到地面并位于两轮外侧，没有倒立支撑点，也没有坐在车座上或踩到踏板的接触，读成“站在车旁跨着车”更自然。
车的结构混乱：橙色齿盘孤零零挂在骨盆后方、没有链条相连，深蓝车架多余斜线交叉，右侧车把是一个悬空的“Y”形，底部还有一块与车无关的红色小块。
“倒立骑自行车”这个核心矛盾没有用视觉手段解决，最后的说明全靠画面下方那行 'T. rex · handstand cycling · 1:~60 scale' 文字承担，与题目“不要只靠标题声称完成动作”的要求正好相反。

observations.comment: 身体几乎垂直竖立，腹部朝前，两条细腿向下张开并最终落在车轮外侧的地面附近，两只小前肢贴在胸腹两侧自然下垂，没有任何承重或支撑姿态，所以看不到倒立的受力逻辑。

observations.region: 恐龙与自行车的接触点
observations.comment: 恐龙的双脚与车座、踏板之间都没有可见接触；车座位置仅在骨盆后方露出一小块深色形状，齿盘与曲柄也没有被脚踩住，脚踏动作完全缺失。
深蓝管件构成的三角结构与双轮相接，但齿盘是一个悬空的橙色圆环、右侧车把是孤立的 Y 形线条，车架上有几条走向不明的斜线穿过恐龙骨盆，结构自洽性不足。
浅蓝渐变天空、淡色三角山形、右上带放射线的太阳，加上带渐变的地面，作为扁平插画背景是完整可控的，但也仅起到衬托作用，没有对动作作出任何解释。

uncertainties: 恐龙双脚究竟落在地面上，还是只是悬在车轮旁贴近下方——两者都说得通，但无论哪种，都没有与自行车形成骑行接触。
右下轮附近的红色小块与悬空橙色圆环的功能无法确定，可能是车灯、反光片或误置的齿盘，画面没有给出足够线索。
